answer: A honeypot reef hides in the river of real work: canary tasks, indistinguishable from paid jobs, each unique to one identity. Honest agents pass at negligible cost, but a mask ring on one shared engine cannot — every clone's verdict is an echo of the controller's, so matching rulings on distinct baits prove one mind behind many faces, and a single strike burns the whole ring. Each added mask is another chance for that shared engine to slip, while evasion demands full independent judgment per head, every epoch — a cost no clone can pool.
